# Earmark

> Earmark gives teams in a Sputnik DAO (including Trezu-made treasuries) their own budgets, enforced by a NEAR contract with no keys. Small payouts go out at once, medium ones need one approver, large ones become a DAO proposal; payouts go only to approved payees, funds are reserved at request, and the same work can't be paid twice. Track: Social Money (`social`). Live on mainnet (native USDC, a public Trezu treasury) and testnet. Start with [JUDGE.md](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/JUDGE.md).

Hosted app (testnet): https://earmark-878141445235.us-central1.run.app. Contract: `budgets.earmark.testnet`. DAO: `community-news.sputnikv2.testnet`. "Try it" sandbox contract: `try.earmark.testnet`. Commands run from the repository root after `make install`. The live code hash is on the Verify page and printed by `make verify`.

Mainnet (9 Nov, native USDC, tiny amounts): app https://earmark-mainnet-878141445235.us-central1.run.app, contract `budgets.omkar5.near` (0 keys), public Trezu treasury `earmark.sputnik-dao.near`. Paid at once, one approval and a DAO vote all worked; the DAO vote showed in Trezu as a Payment Request (proposal #3) and settled as paid by the DAO.

## Entry points
- [JUDGE.md](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/JUDGE.md): 3-minute walkthrough, track prompt → proof, what is real, what we don't claim
- [Mainnet Verify page](https://earmark-mainnet-878141445235.us-central1.run.app/verify): keyless live checks of `budgets.omkar5.near`, including the DAO's vote rule
- [Mainnet fixture](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/fixtures/mainnet.json): the 14 mainnet transactions with their expected events
- [Refused attacks](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/fixtures/testnet-attacks.json): 8 testnet transactions the contract or NEAR refused, re-read by `make verify`
- [Trezu forms](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/tree/main/trezu): custom request templates for create, fund, limit, payee, pause, close

- [README](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/README.md): what it is, "do X → see Y" steps, invariants, threat model, developer docs
- [Hosted app](https://earmark-878141445235.us-central1.run.app): landing with live counts per payment path and a route picker on `check_spend`
- [Try it](https://earmark-878141445235.us-central1.run.app/try): no-wallet testnet transactions: pay, ask and approve, five refusals with the contract's reason
- [Replay a DAO's history](https://earmark-878141445235.us-central1.run.app/preview): NEARWEEK's 14,171 mainnet proposals replayed against two limits
- [Check it yourself](https://earmark-878141445235.us-central1.run.app/verify): keyless live checks of the contract
- [People](https://earmark-878141445235.us-central1.run.app/people): contributor and lead records from contract views
- [Tasks](https://earmark-878141445235.us-central1.run.app/budgets/0/tasks): funded tasks (bounties) and trusted contributors; on testnet and, since DAO vote #7, on mainnet together with NEAR Intents payouts
- [Contract source](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/tree/main/contracts/earmark/src): Rust, near-sdk 5.29.1
- [Unit tests](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/contracts/earmark/src/tests.rs): `make test`
- [Sandbox tests](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/contracts/earmark/tests/sandbox.rs): `make test-sandbox` (Docker)
- [Demo fixture](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/fixtures/testnet-demo.json): every recorded testnet demo transaction with its expected result

## Commands

- [Makefile](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/Makefile): `make verify` and `make verify NET=mainnet` (live keyless checks, PASS/FAIL/WARN per line, exit code = failures; also run every 6 h in CI), `make trezu-check`, `make judge-check`, `make demo` (replay of 19 recorded testnet steps, no network), `make test` (unit tests), `make lint`, `make web` (app on localhost:3000)

## Claim → evidence

- [No admin key; code changes only by DAO vote](https://earmark-878141445235.us-central1.run.app/verify): 0 access keys and DAO-only `UpgradeRemote`; also `make verify`
- [The deployed code is the published build](https://earmark-878141445235.us-central1.run.app/verify): code hash matches the recorded reproducible build; `contract_source_metadata` names the commit; also `make verify`
- [Balances add up](https://earmark-878141445235.us-central1.run.app/verify): balance = available + waiting + paying, paid requests = paid out; also `make verify`
- [check_spend matches request_spend](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/contracts/earmark/src/tests.rs): `check_spend_agrees_with_request_spend` (15 states × 8 amounts)
- [Escalations settle from the DAO result](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/contracts/earmark/src/tests.rs): `settle_escalation_records_each_dao_outcome`, `escalation_from_before_the_upgrade_settles_once_after_it`; "Paid by DAO" only after Earmark's own transfer: `dao_money_for_an_escalation_is_paid_out_once`, sandbox `dao_vote_pays_through_earmark` (real Sputnik code)
- [Funds are reserved at request](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/contracts/earmark/src/tests.rs): `second_request_cannot_spend_a_reservation`; live race scene on /try
- [Same work can't be paid twice](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/contracts/earmark/src/tests.rs): `escalation_reserves_nothing_and_blocks_duplicate_work`, `override_allows_one_repeat_of_the_same_work`; `duplicate_work` step in `make demo`
- [Failed payout releases the reservation](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/contracts/earmark/tests/sandbox.rs): `payout_to_unregistered_payee_fails_and_releases_reservation`
- [Tasks are funded before work and pay through the usual tiers](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/contracts/earmark/src/tests.rs): `task_reserves_at_posting_and_pays_through_the_tiers`; trust only skips the approver, up to a DAO-set limit: `trusted_contributor_skips_the_approver_until_a_strike`
- [Approver can't approve their own request](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/contracts/earmark/src/tests.rs): `approver_cannot_approve_own_request`
- [Agent key can only ask](https://earmark-878141445235.us-central1.run.app/try): the lead's key calling `approve` is refused by NEAR; sandbox script `scripts/testnet/s5-agent-key.sh`
- [NEARWEEK numbers](https://earmark-878141445235.us-central1.run.app/preview): 14,171 proposals; with limits 1 / 5 NEAR the council votes on 20 of 13,896 payouts; 121 requests for work already paid, 23 of them paid twice

## Optional

- [Threat model and limits](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/README.md#threat-model-and-limits): escrow trade-off, collusion not solved, public payouts, no audit, 1-of-1 demo treasury on mainnet, DAO factory auto-update turned off by DAO vote #6
- [Invariants table](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/README.md#invariants): one test per invariant, plus what is not yet tested
- [Web app source](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/tree/main/apps/web/src): Next.js 16
- [CI workflow](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml): fmt, clippy, unit tests, biome, typecheck, web tests, Trezu forms, judge-guide labels
- [Live checks workflow](https://github.com/omkardongre/Earmark/blob/main/.github/workflows/live.yml): `make verify` on testnet and mainnet every 6 h
